framings.label: Domestic political fallout of the war
framings.description: Posts treat the Iran war mainly as a U.S. electoral and partisan story, covering the midterm loss, Democratic and Republican criticism, and calls for Hegseth's removal.

framings.label: Administration defending war and resolve
framings.description: Posts relay Trump and Hegseth portraying the war as historic and successful, and describing Iran as largely destroyed, with strikes still possible alongside talk of diplomacy.

framings.label: Negotiation and de-escalation track
framings.description: Posts focus on diplomatic channels, nuclear proposals via Qatar, reports of a possible deal or peace talks, and the resulting moves in oil prices.

framings.label: Economic and household cost
framings.description: Posts frame the conflict through its costs, including per-household expense, oil price swings, and market reactions to escalation risk.

framings.label: Military and regional operations
framings.description: Posts report on battlefield and strategic developments, such as Hormuz incidents, drone shootdowns, base construction, Russian arms supplies, Iran-Russia contacts, sanctions, and Israeli politics and U.S. support.
